what: 望 (wàng): what is trending in Chinese media right now, translated. A feed to explore. Nothing here is scored or read by Prism.
source: Each platform's own public hot list, read directly by chinavision-pull.py. Not read this time: Zhihu: HTTPError HTTP Error 403: Forbidden.
notesBy: Accounts, quotes and reception are written by local:qwen, on this Mac from the news pages it read. Reception is what those pages themselves report; no comment threads are read. Accounts are in its own words; a quote is kept only when it is found exactly in its source and is short. The full texts stay on this Mac (data/chinavision/raw/) and are not shown.

items.zh: 中俄美元首会晤
items.en: Meeting between the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States
items.note: Chinese state media reports that President Xi Jinping and US President Trump met in Shenzhen during the APEC summit, where Trump stated his administration does not support Taiwan independence. Scholars interviewed by the outlet interpret this as a positive signal for strategic stability and a more cautious US approach to cross-strait issues. The article highlights that this clear stance helps reduce risks of miscalculation by separatist forces and reflects deepened mutual trust from recent high-level interactions. Experts note that while the verbal commitment is significant, future actions regarding arms sales and official visits will be key to verifying US consistency.

items.zh: 习近平主持中俄美元首会晤
items.en: Xi Jinping hosts a trilateral meeting of the presidents of China, Russia, and the United States
items.note: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and US President Donald Trump held a historic trilateral meeting in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. The article states the summit produced a joint Peace Declaration aimed at maintaining global stability and preventing conflict between the major powers. Wang Yi characterized the event as a constructive 'peace summit' that established a new model for great power coordination. The report emphasizes that the leaders agreed to uphold peaceful coexistence and address global challenges through enhanced diplomatic communication.

items.zh: Anthropic上市如何影响全球AI格局
items.en: How will Anthropic's IPO affect the global AI landscape
items.note: Anthropic, a leading artificial intelligence research firm, has officially listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange, setting its initial share price at $83 and achieving a fully diluted market capitalization of $1.5 trillion. The company reported explosive revenue growth, reaching $16.2 billion in the first half of 2026, but also faces massive losses driven by high costs in computing power and one-time expenses. As the first frontier AI developer to go public, its financial performance is being closely watched by Wall Street as a key indicator of the broader AI investment trend. The firm's leadership emphasizes the immense financial and resource commitments required to train advanced AI models while acknowledging potential societal risks.
